svg.title: GPTQ lazy batch updates: memory traffic comparison
svg.desc: Two-panel diagram comparing naive per-column HBM round-trips against lazy batch updates that buffer 128 columns in SRAM before a single flush, achieving 128x less memory traffic.

g.text: Lazy batch: accumulate 128 cols, then flush
32 flushes total (4096 ÷ 128) × 32 MiB ≈ 2 GiB moved — 128× less traffic
